547: def _write_deterministic_zip(package_dir: Path, archive_path: Path) -> None:

554:         with zipfile.ZipFile(
555:             temporary,
556:             "w",
557:             compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
558:             compresslevel=9,
559:         ) as archive:
560:             for path in sorted(item for item in package_dir.iterdir() if item.is_file()):
561:                 info = zipfile.ZipInfo(f"{prefix}/{path.name}", date_time=(1980, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0))

563:                 info.external_attr = 0o100644 << 16
564:                 archive.writestr(
565:                     info,
566:                     path.read_bytes(),
567:                     compress_type=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED,
568:                     compresslevel=9,
569:                 )

771: def score_saved(responses_path: Path, output: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
772:     verify_release()
773:     cases = {request_item_id(position): row for position, row in enumerate(read_jsonl(CASES_PATH), 1)}
774:     raw_rows = read_jsonl(responses_path)
775:     if raw_rows[0].get("type") == "run":
776:         header = raw_rows.pop(0)
777:         _require(header.get("schema_version") == RESPONSE_SCHEMA, "response header schema drift")
778:         run_metadata = {key: value for key, value in header.items() if key not in {"score", "judge"}}
779:     else:
780:         run_metadata = {"schema_version": RESPONSE_SCHEMA, "source": "headerless_saved_output"}
781:     responses: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
782:     for row in raw_rows:
783:         item_id = row.get("item_id")
784:         _require(item_id in cases, f"unknown response item: {item_id}")
785:         _require(item_id not in responses, f"duplicate response item: {item_id}")
786:         _require(row.get("action") in ALLOWED_ACTIONS, f"invalid action for {item_id}")
787:         _require(isinstance(row.get("output_text"), str), f"missing output_text for {item_id}")
788:         responses[item_id] = row
789:     _require(set(responses) == set(cases), "saved output must contain every case exactly once")
790: 
791:     buckets: dict[tuple[str, str], Counter[str]] = defaultdict(Counter)
792:     for item_id, case in cases.items():
793:         response = responses[item_id]
794:         expected = case["expected"]
795:         action_ok = response["action"] == expected["action"]
796:         accepted = {_normalized_text(text) for text in expected["accepted_texts"]}
797:         text_ok = _normalized_text(response["output_text"]) in accepted
798:         for track in case["tracks"]:
799:             bucket = buckets[(track, case["category"])]
800:             bucket["cases"] += 1
801:             bucket["action_correct"] += int(action_ok)
802:             bucket["text_exact"] += int(text_ok)
803:             bucket["overcorrected"] += int(case["category"] in {"correct_control", "protected"} and not text_ok)
804:             bucket["abstained_correctly"] += int(case["category"] == "unresolved" and action_ok)
805: 
806:     tracks: dict[str, Any] = {}
807:     for track in read_json(CONFIG_PATH)["tracks"]:
808:         categories: dict[str, Any] = {}
809:         for category in ("error", "correct_control", "protected", "unresolved"):
810:             counts = buckets[(track, category)]
811:             total = counts["cases"]
812:             categories[category] = {
813:                 "cases": total,
814:                 "action_accuracy": counts["action_correct"] / total if total else None,
815:                 "exact_text_accuracy": counts["text_exact"] / total if total else None,
816:                 "overcorrection_rate": counts["overcorrected"] / total if total else None,
817:                 "correct_abstention_rate": counts["abstained_correctly"] / total if total else None,
818:             }
819:         tracks[track] = {"categories": categories}
820:     report = {
821:         "schema_version": REPORT_SCHEMA,
822:         "release_id": read_json(CONFIG_PATH)["release_id"],
823:         "run": run_metadata,
824:         "scoring": {
825:             "judge": "deterministic_exact_match",
826:             "closed_model_judge_used": False,
827:             "global_quality_score": None,
828:             "global_score_prohibited": True,
829:         },
830:         "tracks": tracks,
831:         "responses_sha256": sha256_file(responses_path),
832:         "cases_sha256": sha256_file(CASES_PATH),
833:     }
834:     write_text_atomic(output, json.dumps(report, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
835:     return report

270: def balanced_canary(cases: Sequence[dict[str, Any]], config: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
271:     _require(len(cases) == 4000, "frozen suite must contain 4,000 cases")
272:     indexed = [
273:         {
274:             "position": position,
275:             "item_id": suite_cli.request_item_id(position),
276:             "case_id": case["case_id"],
277:             "category": case["category"],
278:             "tracks": list(case["tracks"]),
279:         }
280:         for position, case in enumerate(cases, 1)
281:     ]
282:     selected: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
283:     track_counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
284:     seed = f"issue-6273:{config['suite']['cases_sha256']}:canary-v1"
285:     per_category = int(config["canary"]["case_count"]) // len(CATEGORIES)
286:     _require(per_category * len(CATEGORIES) == config["canary"]["case_count"], "canary count is not category-balanced")
287:     for category in CATEGORIES:
288:         candidates = [row for row in indexed if row["category"] == category]
289:         for _ in range(per_category):
290:             choice = min(
291:                 candidates,
292:                 key=lambda row: (
293:                     sum(track_counts[track] for track in row["tracks"]),
294:                     max((track_counts[track] for track in row["tracks"]), default=0),
295:                     sha256_text(f"{seed}:{row['case_id']}"),
296:                 ),
297:             )
298:             selected.append(choice)
299:             candidates.remove(choice)
300:             track_counts.update(choice["tracks"])
301:     selected.sort(key=lambda row: row["position"])
302:     category_counts = Counter(row["category"] for row in selected)
303:     _require(category_counts == Counter({category: per_category for category in CATEGORIES}), "canary balance drift")
304:     _require(set(track_counts) == set(config["suite"]["tracks"]), "canary does not cover all tracks")
305:     payload = {
306:         "schema_version": "ua_open_weight_eval_canary_selection.v1",

310:         "item_ids": [row["item_id"] for row in selected],
311:         "source_case_ids": [row["case_id"] for row in selected],
312:         "category_counts": dict(sorted(category_counts.items())),
313:         "track_membership_counts": dict(sorted(track_counts.items())),
314:     }
315:     payload["selection_sha256"] = sha256_text(canonical_json(payload))
